goal.name: Liver health
goal.definition: Liver fat content (hepatic steatosis), liver enzymes (ALT/AST), liver stiffness/fibrosis stage, and hepatic insulin sensitivity as measurable markers of non-alcoholic and alcohol-related fatty liver disease risk and progression.
